pages.title: Mobs to Experience
pages.text: The same folding, for the living. It takes $(thing)mob drops$() or essences with water, breaks them down, condenses its own fluid and renders $(thing)liquid experience$().
Its heart is grown around a nether star too, with echo shards, and the essences of ghast tears, shulkers, blazes and phantoms. Things that fly and burn, and remember.
It remembers every creature that went into it. I try not to listen. Each stage costs what its own machine would.

pages.name: Experience Nexus
pages.text: Three cores on pedestals, a cauldron in front.

pages.title: The Altar
pages.text: A destructuration, a condensator and a rendering core on their pedestals, and on the floor before them a cauldron that shows the experience.$(br2)Its front turns to whoever sets it down.

pages.title: Drinking
pages.text: I take the experience the same ways as from a $(l:machines/rendering)rendering cauldron$(). By bucket or pipe, from its window, through taps on any of its stones, or through one bound siphon.$(br2)It too needs its $(l:energy/wormholes)wormhole$().
